# vLLM-Omni Duo Runtime

This directory contains the vLLM-Omni runtime and Duo streaming inference
integration. Upstream project: [vLLM-Omni](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni).

See the [branch-level README](../../README.md), [Duo Serving](docs/serving/duo.md),
and the [browser demo](apps/duo/README.md). The upstream license is available in
[LICENSE](LICENSE); additional notices remain alongside their corresponding
source files.
